scripts.deploy:stack: bun run build:api && sam deploy --profile jgyy --config-file samconfig.toml
scripts.deploy:guided: bun run build:api && sam deploy --guided --profile jgyy --config-file samconfig.toml
scripts.deploy:web: bun run build:web && bun run scripts/sync-web.ts && bun run scripts/invalidate.ts
scripts.deploy:all: bun run deploy:stack && bun run seed && bun run deploy:web
scripts.seed: bun run scripts/seed-snippets.ts && bun run scripts/seed-daily.ts
scripts.outputs: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name codetype-solo --profile jgyy --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs' --output table
